messages:
Maria: kicking off the canary for the heterogeneous spot pool in us-west-2. goal: validate mixed-instance launch template, interruption handler, and tagging for cost attribution. PR: #1357. will target a small canary group (~8 GPUs) for 30m. please monitor ENI attach errors, pod evictions, and gpu scheduling failures.
Akshay: SGTM. a couple asks: (1) set spot price_hysteresis = 0.08 to reduce churn, (2) add tag "cost-center=ml" and "team=infra" for chargeback, (3) avoid changing node IAM role if possible.
Jon: noting ENI limits — p4d/hosts have stricter ENI attach characteristics; we should validate attach concurrency. also double-check subnet IP availability in us-west-2a for the canary AZ.
Lina: we observed race where interruption hits during cloud-init and kubelet never registers the node properly. recommend configuring interruption handler with GRACE_PERIOD=90 and running drain w/ \`kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force\` in the handler.
Ethan: also propose adding a node taint: "spot=true:NoExecute" and a simple fallback daemonset that reschedules critical pods onto dedicated nodes when a spot node gets the taint. keeps UX stable.
sre-bot: canary orchestration started: env=canary region=us-west-2 pool=spot-hetero-1. metrics enabled: gpu_util, attach_errors, pod_evictions, kube_schedule_failures. alerts: attach_errors > 1 in 10m -> page oncall.
deploy-bot: terraform apply to canary workspace succeeded. launch_template version bumped to v27. autoscaler config pointed at canary ASG.
Maria: first 12m: 2 attach errors logged. stack: "failed to attach ENI: device busy". also one pod eviction tied to preemption signal timing. pasting minimal log: ```Mar 15 02:11:22 ip-10-0-1-23 kernel: esi: failed to attach ENI: device busy
Mar 15 02:11:24 kubelet[1234]: Node not ready: lost kubelet registration after preempted NIC\```
Akshay: we should add aws-sdk retry backoff to the ENI attach callsite. try setting awsapi_retries = 5 in the launch template userdata wrapper. also bump the instance weighting so h100 gets higher weight for capacity math.
Jon: scheduling test plan: run scale-to-zero then scale-up 3x across AZs overnight, watch cross-AZ egress and pod startup latency (esp for H100 images). also check ENI quotas per AZ — I'll open a support ticket if we hit limits.
Lina: one more: add AMI metadata tag so the CI can select spot-safe AMIs: "spot-ami:2026-03-15". also ensure the AMI includes the interruption-handler systemd unit and kubelet config to honor graceful termination.
Ethan: rollback plan documented: revert LT to v26, set cluster-autoscaler to prefer dedicated pool via nodeSelector, and mark canary ASG as drain-only. we should be able to flip a flag in infra-config to force dedicated fallback if >5 pod evictions in 30m.
Maria: merging PR in 1h if no regressions. stop-gap: if attach_errors >3 -> pause rollout and escalate. tagging: will add "team=ml" "cost-center=ml". thanks all :thumbsup: :eyes:
Akshay: small terraform snippet for launch_template userdata we used in the canary: ```resource "aws_launch_template" "spot_hetero" {
  name_prefix   = "spot-hetero-canary-"
  user_data     = base64encode(file("userdata/spot-init.sh"))
  tag_specifications {
    resource_type = "instance"
    tags = { Team = "ml" CostCenter = "ml" SpotAmi = "spot-ami:2026-03-15" }
  }
  instance_market_options {
    market_type = "spot"
    spot_options {
      instance_interruption_behavior = "terminate"
      spot_instance_type = "one-time"
    }
  }
}
```
Jon: will run the overnight scale tests and post back results in the morning. if we see more than 5 attach errors or any sustained scheduling failures we'll rollback.
Lina: thanks — I'll update the runbook with the new handler flags and the drain command. adding a note about ENI attach backoff and the 90s grace.
Ethan: confirming dedicated pool fallback daemonset ready in repo infra/fallback-daemonset. good to go from my side.
Maria: final: keep an eye on cost delta vs baseline. aim is 30-40% GPU cost savings w/ acceptable 1-2% increase in OOM/pod restarts. merge after 60m if green.
